{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blazer, cropped fit to balance height, charcoal gray (#36454f), wool blend.
Wide-leg trousers, relaxed but structured cut, forest green (#2d4f38), heavy cotton twill.
Silk blouse, tailored collar with a subtle sheen, cream white (#fdfbf7), raw silk.
Leather ankle boots, low heel for crowd navigation, dark brown (#3e2723), smooth calfskin.

This outfit balances the need for movement in a crowded club with a strictly classic aesthetic requested by her. The charcoal blazer and wide-leg trousers create a polished silhouette that stands out against typical concert attire while remaining comfortable enough to stand and walk all night. The forest green pants add a subtle rock-edge contrast without breaking the refined registers she desires, and the cream silk blouse ensures the look remains elegant under artificial club lighting."}
